title: Credits and other taxes — three clients
instructions: Compute the 2025 amounts for three unrelated clients, then classify the credits.

exhibits.title: Clients
exhibits.content:
1. **Dana** (MFJ, AGI $95,000; both spouses work) paid $7,200 of after-school care for two children, ages 9 and 11.
2. **Eli** (single, MAGI $60,000) paid $5,000 of tuition for his first year of college (half-time) and $900 of required books.
3. **Fay** (single) has 2025 taxable income of $180,000, which reflects $25,000 of state and local taxes deducted. She also exercised ISOs with a $90,000 bargain element and received $5,000 of private activity bond interest. Her regular tax is $36,000. Her AMT exemption isn't phased out; use 26% for AMTI up to $239,100 over the exemption.
